title: Scorecard
description: A scorecard rates the entities of one blueprint against a ladder of tiers, such as bronze, silver and gold, each a set of jq checks. To show results in the catalog, the blueprint declares a property with type: scorecard naming it.

blueprint.description: The blueprint whose entities it scores.

filter.description: Scores only the entities that match. There's no viewer or page, so variables such as $me don't apply.

tiers.description: The tiers, lowest first. An entity reaches a tier by meeting its criteria and every tier's below.

name.description: The tier's identifier, unique in the scorecard, such as gold. Paths read it as <property>.tier.

title.description: The tier's label. Defaults to its name.

criteria.description: The checks for this tier, keyed by identifier, unique across all tiers.

title.description: What the check asks, such as Has an owner. Defaults to its identifier.

check.description: jq over the entity giving true or false, such as .owner != null. Lookups and scorecard properties are there too.

when.description: jq over the entity; the check only applies to entities it's true for, such as .critical.

fix.description: What to do when the check fails, shown to the entity's owners.
